scope: VCVio deprecation migration, stage S2 (plan doc/impl/vcvio-deprecation-migration-plan.md section 7, the leaf families): restatement of 40 theorems and of the bodies of two probability definitions of 15 modules in VCVio's forward vocabulary (Pr{let x <- mx}[...] and EvalDistEq), with out-of-build certificates (41 by the inverse vocabulary map, PqxdhChallengeSecretRouting.honest_decapsulation by the plan's textual fallback); the first transitional twins (11) and their later-stage consumers; phase B proof rewrites in these files; Lean-only validation.

commits.64746489: Migrate VCVio stage S2 to the forward probability vocabulary
commits.docs: the commit that adds this receipt

lean_changes.statements: probOutput -> Pr{let x <- mx}[x = a]; probEvent -> Pr{let x <- mx}[p x] (old lambda binder names kept); evalSPMF A = evalSPMF B -> EvalDistEq A B (amendment A1, no =ᵈ); honest_decapsulation: evalSPMF X = pure (some secret) -> EvalDistEq X (pure (some secret) : ProbComp _)
lean_changes.docs_in_modules: module documents of CtxRomAuth and StatefulGoodEvent (forward vocabulary, bridge-mediated dependencies); PqxdhBoundaryDeployment(Later) module documents and the classical_evalDist docstring name the event form
lean_changes.codemod: pin-filtered upstream codemod on copies of the 15 files (logs/codemod.log: 74 hand sites); =ᵈ rewritten to EvalDistEq by hand (A1)

findings.semantics_instance: Pr{...} on ProbComp elaborates with the native PFunctor.FreeM.instEvalDistSemanticsFreeM in all 15 modules, with or without the VCVioForwardOracleComp import (probe scratch/inst); on OracleComp CtxRO (64-byte answers without a measurable structure) and over a generic [IsUniformSpec spec'] it elaborates with the SPMF adapter instEvalDistSemanticsOfMonadLiftTSPMF in both cases; adding the measurable hypotheses that native semantics needs is forbidden (plan section 3), so these statements use the adapter; adapter users after the stage: BeaconcryptCore.Computational.CtxRomAuth, BeaconcryptCore.Computational.StatefulGoodEvent, BeaconcryptCore.Computational.VCVioLegacyBridge
findings.kernel_memory: the uniform-marginal card arithmetic over the concrete 32-byte vector types exhausted the kernel's memory ("excessive memory consumption"); a local counting fact over arbitrary finite types, instantiated, checks in about two seconds
findings.simp_bridge_leak: UniformTargetSelection.split's plain simp calls used the pin's simp bridge evalDist_apply_singleton (and with it PFunctor.FreeM.instDiscreteEvalDistCompatibleOfCompatible); the calls now exclude the three bridges
findings.relocated_equation_lemma: SPMF.boolDistAdvantage.eq_1 is generated on demand; it moved from PqxdhSecretInputInitializer (whose proof no longer unfolds SPMF.boolDistAdvantage) to PqxdhRegistrationJointKemGame (which unfolds it at line 120), identical in kind, universes, hashes, fingerprints and instance flag; its (module, constant) pairs moved with it (constants from a probe: SPMF, Bool, Eq, Real, SPMF.boolDistAdvantage, MeasureTheory.Measure.boolDist, SPMF.toMeasure, Bool.instMeasurableSpace)
findings.rename_tool_defect: twin_rename.py renamed the own header of the four consumers named event_good (RawCtxFlaggedQueryAgreement, RawCtxSelectedParentLive, PqxdhRecordFactsOriginMuteAdaptive, RawCtxSelectedLiveEvents); fixed (a bare suffix equal to the consumer's own name is never a reference), headers repaired, fixed tool rerun on base copies reproduces the repaired files byte for byte
